method: All 650 canonical scene titles inventoried, all 133 Miyagi causal premises reviewed, actual four-gram text compared for 68,761 pairs and candidate scenes inspected. Selected full reference exchanges inspected for substantive replacement cases; other comparisons use scene titles and causal premises. Scores are retrieval aids, not evidence of semantic approval. This is an AI author/editor review, not an independent human review.

retainedMeaningLevelCases.reason: First reports a parked vehicle seen from inside work, without face or plate; second witnesses an actual collision and supplies personal location. Evidence-reporting language recurs but event, known facts and requested handling differ.

Damaged bag of fruit was discovered unopened on shelf; frozen goods were softened during the customers own shopping. Reporting a pre-existing defect differs from reporting self-caused warming and allowing resale decision.
Recording for later memory requires permission and verified paper notes; interpreter phone for a distant family member supplies a different language channel and participant-consent problem.

Company requires a specific paper transaction record separately from electronic notice setting; earlier scene concerns private notification reception. The outstanding document requirement drives the new request.
